sources.prompt: Prompt not supplied. Visual description of the supplied artwork: a line-art coloring page of two smiling children in matching patterned pajamas hugging on a big cushioned couch. How the image was created was not stated.
sources.humanModifications: Received as an 896×1195 portrait JPEG (IMG_1048.jpeg) that included a busy kitchen background. Cropped off the top kitchen area (kept the children and couch), centered on a square white canvas and rescaled to 1024×1024; converted to PNG; thresholded to pure black lines on pure white to remove JPEG noise. Lines were not thickened, so they are thinner than the guide's 10-16 px target, and the pajama patterns create many small regions (documented exception, rated advanced). On 2026-11-27 the solid-black shadow areas between the children were turned white (a thin outline kept) so they can be colored with the paint bucket. Thumbnail created at 420×420. Passed visual inspection; not functionally tested with the paint bucket.
